title: Receptionist
description: As the first point of contact for patients, the Receptionist ensures safe, efficient, and compassionate access to care. Working on the front desk and over the phone, you will manage incoming calls, assess patient needs using triage protocols, schedule appointments, and direct patients to the appropriate healthcare professional. This role is vital to supporting the smooth day-to-day operation of the practice. Strong multitasking skills, empathy, teamwork and the ability to stay calm under pressure are essential! Working Pattern: Hours: Part time, 20 hours per week Schedule: Mondays, Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Fridays (a mix of morning and afternoon shifts) Please note: Due to confidentiality and data protection guidelines, staff members are generally required not to be registered as patients at the practice. If appointed and are registered with us, you will be asked to register with an alternative local GP surgery. Some of the Key Responsibilities: - Greet, check in, and direct patients warmly at the front desk. - Manage incoming telephone calls, assess needs via triage protocols, and book appointments using the EMIS clinical system and Accrx booking link. - Respond to patient enquiries and resolve queries efficiently, escalating complex issues where necessary. - Initiate and respond to requests from patients, practice staff, and external healthcare agencies in a professional and timely manner. The following are the core responsibilities of the Receptionists. There may occasionally be a requirement to carry out other duties depending on workload, operational needs and staffing levels. Primary Responsibilities: Receive and process correspondence from hospitals, external healthcare providers, and other agencies. Scan and upload documents onto the Docman / EMIS clinical system, ensuring accurate patient record management. Review and appropriately allocate documents within Docman / EMIS , forwarding them to the relevant clinician for review and action. Initiate and respond to requests from patients, practice staff, and external healthcare agencies in a professional and timely manner. Photocopy and prepare documentation as required by clinicians and practice staff. Provide cover for colleagues during periods of absence to ensure continuity of service. Accurately input patient information and updates into EMIS where required. Manage and resolve patient queries efficiently, escalating issues where appropriate. Maintain a clean, organised, and efficient reception environment at all times. Support the clinical team with day-to-day operational tasks as required. Complete tasks relating to patient results, correspondence, and clinical letters where appropriate. Demonstrate flexibility and adaptability in managing changing workloads and priorities to ensure the smooth operation of the practice. Use EMIS, Docman, AccRx and other digital systems effectively for patient record management, appointment scheduling, and internal communication.

Assess and escalate where appropriate. Prepare lists and notes for all surgeries and clinics held, ensuring completion of all associated paperwork. Enter accurate patient consultations and information on to the computer as required. Ensure records are kept in good repair with all necessary information on the outside cover clearly visible.
